blocks.text: Enzymes proteins hain jo jaandaron ke kimiyai reactions ke liye hayatiyati catalysts ka kaam karte hain; yeh biochemical reactions ko itna tez karte hain jitna in ke baghair na-mumkin hota. Maslan khoon mein enzyme carbonic anhydrase ka aik molecule aik second mein taqreeban das lakh (one million) carbon dioxide aur paani ke molecules ko carbonic acid mein badal sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke carbonic anhydrase ka aik molecule aik minute mein taqreeban das lakh molecules badalta hai. Napi gayi raftaar (rate) is se kaheen zyada hai: taqreeban das lakh molecules har second. Is liye sabaq 'aik second' likhta hai.

Enzyme ki satah par aik khaas jagah, active site, hoti hai jo substrate molecule ko jor kar products mein badalti hai. Enzymes bohat makhsoos hain: har aik sirf aik khaas substrate par kaam karta hai, kyunke active site ki anokhi shakal mein sirf wahi substrate fit hota hai. Be-tarteeb harkat substrate molecules ko active site mein lati hai, aur aarzi enzyme-substrate complex banta hai; phir products nikal jate aur enzyme, be-tabdeel, doosre substrate molecule se jurne ke liye azad hota hai. Yeh 1894 mein Emil Fischer ke pesh kiye lock and key model se samjhaya jata hai: enzyme taala aur substrate chaabi hai, aur sirf durust shakal ki chaabi surakh (active site) mein fit hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Laal substrate jis ke neeche teen nokein hain, neele enzyme ke oopar hai jis mein waisa hi zigzag kataao, active site, hai. Teer enzyme-substrate complex tak jata hai jis mein substrate active site mein theek baith jata hai.

blocks.text: Enzymes hazme mein bhi hissa lete hain: hazme ke enzymes starch, proteins aur charbi jaise khurak ke bare molecules ko chhote molecules mein torte hain jinhein jism jazb kar sake.

blocks.prompt: Enzyme sirf aik substrate par kyun kaam karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ki active site ki anokhi shakal (aur groups ki tarteeb) hai jis mein sirf wahi substrate fit hota hai, jaisa lock and key model mein.

items: Enzymes: protein catalysts; substrate active site se jurta.
Lock and key model (Fischer, 1894); enzymes khurak hazam karte.
